study_protocol.rationale: Four hours before target midnight; permits recent complete station bins and evening forecast inputs. Prefetch at 19:50; freeze cached inputs at 20:00. Availability must be audited empirically, not assumed.
study_protocol.target: station-level AirGuard CPCB-style AQI estimate from measured hourly concentrations only

target_rules.gas: maximum complete trailing 8h window ending in day; prior 7h support
target_rules.lower_bound: Severe >=401 is censored; excluded from exact regression and error metrics, retained for category diagnostics

eligibility.station_binding: chosen before target, within 25 km, no post-outcome station selection

features.A: CAMS forecast concentrations, daily AQI and hourly descriptors
features.B: issue-time measured lags and rolling summaries
features.F: optional fire context; excluded by default pending ablation

splits.final_test: Latest 90 global target dates locked before model selection; evaluate once, reproducible rerun only at same data/protocol/source hash

advisory.control: empirical blocked calibration trade-off only; no clinical or distribution-free time-series guarantee

deployment.station_correction: deny by default; approved immutable model and station support evidence required
deployment.wide_intervals: do not abstain on width alone

study_protocol.archive_requirement: Genuine archived issue-time forecast initialization and availability; no reanalysis/past-fields substitute

hypotheses.H1: Station correction lowers held-out MAE vs raw CAMS and persistence; paired date-blocked comparison, Holm correction.
hypotheses.H2: Raw CAMS O3/PM2.5 bias varies by region/season; directions are hypotheses, not precomputed findings.
hypotheses.H3: 80/90% interval coverage within 3 percentage points across seasons/severity; joint pollutant support required for AQI bounds.
hypotheses.H4: Empirical under-warning at most 5% vulnerable/10% general; report over-warning, support and uncertainty.

pending: Real matched archive/station data, verified HAI evidence, human review and elapsed prospective outcomes.
